verdict.rationale: Sierra is a fully-hosted, proprietary SaaS platform with no evidence of any self-hostable/on-prem deployment option; all docs describe cloud product usage, compliance certs for hosted service, and no open-source core or self-hosting instructions exist. Probes for llms.txt/openapi also show no open technical artifacts. Missing for 10: any mention of self-hosting, on-prem deployment, source availability, or Docker/Kubernetes install instructions.
